text:
Maya: Quick note — slight agenda shift for the all-hands today: leadership Q&A will be first so remote folks can drop in early. Also having an on-site AV hiccup: main camera lost HDMI lock twice. Can AV Team advise fallback?

Carlos: ack. moving Q&A up is fine. can we keep time for live captions after Q&A? lots of accessibility asks.

Eve: saw camera glitch during setup. suspect HDMI cable or auto-sleep on the PTZ. logs show repeated HDMI handshakes.

AV Team: On it. immediate fallback options: 1) switch to secondary PTZ via SDI bridge 2) use presenter laptop camera and local OBS composite 3) start direct Meet-only call (no stream) as ultimate fallback. Which do we want?

Jordan: prefer keep stream. go SDI bridge if we can. if not, use laptop OBS and route to backup RTMP. start captions either way.

AV Team: SDI bridge seems flaky too (power flicker). we'll hot-plug the laptop and start OBS scene named "allhands-laptop-fallback". starting now.

MediaBot: Recording created: allhands_preflight_1787619999.mkv (size: 1.2GB)

Eve: note for ops — if we go laptop-OBS fallback, please disable hardware acceleration on the browser to avoid GPU contention on the laptop (chrome --disable-gpu).

Carlos: captions — can we route Zoom/Meet captions into the stream? If not, start auto-captions in OBS (plugin).

AV Team: OBS plugin installed. enabling live captions plugin and setting language to en-US. starting RTMP to rtmp://backup.redwood/ah-1787619999

OpsBot: Network watch: jitter spike detected on conference VLAN at 15:02 UTC. Packet loss transient 0.5%-1%. Monitoring.

Maya: quick round on Q&A logistics: leadership will take 15 mins; open mic for onsite, Slack Q&A thread open for remote. Anyone moderating remote questions?

Jordan: I'll moderate remote Q&A with Priya. Maya will take the on-site queue.

Eve: camera lock restored after reseating HDMI and disabling PTZ auto-sleep. but given instability, keep laptop-OBS as hot backup.

MediaBot: Stream status: primary encoder disconnected at 15:04:12 UTC. Backup encoder (OBS) live at 15:05:02 UTC.

Carlos: thanks. I'm launching the live poll after demos as planned. reminded folks to upvote questions.

Maya: leadership, a heads-up: a roadmap clarifying slide on Dedicated capacity pricing got pushed last minute. will you still be covering it?

Jordan: yes, short segment (3 slides) in the Q&A portion to explain changes and SLA notes. Priya will field detailed pricing follow-ups offline.

AV Team: OBS record active and uploading to NAS as it goes. fallback label: "ah-1787619999-fallback-obs.mp4"

OpsBot: Incident note: conference VLAN jitter returned to baseline at 15:10 UTC. no consumer-facing impact.

MediaBot: Captions active (confidence: 0.92). Transcripts will be available post-event.

Maya: OK team — Q&A is live in 5. thanks for the quick pivot. if you see anything else, ping @AV Team.

Carlos: sending reminder to #all-hands channel to drop questions and vote.

Jordan: closing thread. we'll open a follow-up if we need action items. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
